# ===================================================================
# GOOD EVENTS EXAMPLES
# ===================================================================
# This file demonstrates CORRECT event structure, options, descriptions, and portraits.
# All examples in this file should PASS validation with NO errors.
#
# What this tests:
# - Proper event structure (type, title, desc)
# - Valid option configurations
# - Correct description blocks (triggered_desc, first_valid)
# - Proper portrait placement
# - Valid AI chance configuration
# - Correct control flow (trigger_if, trigger_else)
#
# Expected validation result: NO ERRORS
# ===================================================================

namespace = events_good

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example 1: Complete character event with all elements
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Basic event structure with all required fields
# SHOULD PASS: Yes - has type, title, desc, options
# DEMONSTRATES: Minimal complete event
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
events_good.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = events_good.0001.t
	desc = events_good.0001.desc
	theme = intrigue

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		is_ruler = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = actor
	}

	option = {
		name = events_good.0001.a
		add_gold = 100
	}

	option = {
		name = events_good.0001.b
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# Example 2: Event with conditional descriptions (triggered_desc)
events_good.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = events_good.0002.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					has_trait = brave
				}
				desc = events_good.0002.desc_brave
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					has_trait = craven
				}
				desc = events_good.0002.desc_craven
			}
			# Fallback with always = yes
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					always = yes
				}
				desc = events_good.0002.desc_default
			}
		}
	}

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = events_good.0002.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# Example 3: Event with AI chance modifiers
events_good.0003 = {
	type = character_event
	title = events_good.0003.t
	desc = events_good.0003.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = events_good.0003.a
		add_gold = 100

		ai_chance = {
			base = 50

			modifier = {
				add = 25
				has_trait = greedy
			}

			modifier = {
				factor = 0.5
				has_trait = generous
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = events_good.0003.b
		add_prestige = 50

		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
		}
	}
}

# Example 4: Hidden event (no desc, no options, no portraits)
events_good.0004 = {
	type = character_event
	hidden = yes

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		add_gold = 100
		trigger_event = {
			id = events_good.0005
			days = 30
		}
	}
}

events_good.0005 = {
	type = character_event
	title = events_good.0005.t
	desc = events_good.0005.desc

	left_portrait = root

	option = {
		name = events_good.0005.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# Example 5: Event with multiple portraits
events_good.0006 = {
	type = character_event
	title = events_good.0006.t
	desc = events_good.0006.desc

	left_portrait = root
	right_portrait = {
		character = liege
		animation = personality_rational
	}

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		exists = liege
	}

	option = {
		name = events_good.0006.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# Example 7: Event with triggered options
events_good.0007 = {
	type = character_event
	title = events_good.0007.t
	desc = events_good.0007.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = events_good.0007.a
		trigger = {
			gold >= 100
		}
		remove_short_term_gold = 100
		add_prestige = 200
	}

	option = {
		name = events_good.0007.b
		trigger = {
			prestige >= 50
		}
		add_prestige = -50
		add_gold = 150
	}

	# Fallback option (no trigger - always available)
	option = {
		name = events_good.0007.c
		add_piety = 25
	}
}

# Example 8: Event with after block
events_good.0008 = {
	type = character_event
	title = events_good.0008.t
	desc = events_good.0008.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = events_good.0008.a
		add_gold = 100
	}

	option = {
		name = events_good.0008.b
		add_prestige = 50
	}

	# after block runs after player selects an option
	after = {
		trigger_event = {
			id = events_good.0009
			days = 30
		}
	}
}

events_good.0009 = {
	type = character_event
	title = events_good.0009.t
	desc = events_good.0009.desc

	left_portrait = root

	option = {
		name = events_good.0009.a
		add_piety = 25
	}
}

# Example 10: Letter event type
events_good.0010 = {
	type = letter_event
	title = events_good.0010.t
	opening = events_good.0010.opening
	desc = events_good.0010.desc
	sender = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = events_good.0010.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# Example 11: Event with show_as_unavailable option
events_good.0011 = {
	type = character_event
	title = events_good.0011.t
	desc = events_good.0011.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = events_good.0011.a
		trigger = {
			gold >= 100
		}
		show_as_unavailable = {
			gold < 100
		}
		remove_short_term_gold = 100
		add_prestige = 200
	}

	option = {
		name = events_good.0011.b
		add_piety = 25
	}
}

# Example 12: Event with random_valid descriptions
events_good.0012 = {
	type = character_event
	title = events_good.0012.t
	desc = {
		random_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					always = yes
				}
				desc = events_good.0012.desc_1
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					always = yes
				}
				desc = events_good.0012.desc_2
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					always = yes
				}
				desc = events_good.0012.desc_3
			}
		}
	}

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = events_good.0012.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}
